name: anycar-circuit-compact-v3-silverstone-8
goal: Track a complete compact F1-inspired lap, targeted at 28 seconds within a 30-second episode, avoiding collisions/offtrack.
score: Ordered completion and time-indexed position/heading/speed accuracy. Safety violation gives zero. No nearest-waypoint score.
evaluation_backend: native MuJoCo CPU + OSMesa + NumPy CPU
limitations: Procedural chassis with retained contact-wheel mechanism. Rigid Coulomb friction is not deformable sand. No learned vehicle model is evaluated. F1-inspired: periodic smoothing and minor-axis widening, then 45m normalization. Not exact scaled circuit outlines; tight corners/crossovers may be removed.
geometry: F1-inspired: periodic smoothing and minor-axis widening, then 45m normalization. Not exact scaled circuit outlines; tight corners/crossovers may be removed.

runtime_budget.wall_time_estimate_basis: CPU OSMesa planning estimate; validate on deployment hardware

completion: Every ordered forward gate and the finish line within 30 simulated seconds
visual_feedback: Dashed public commanded centerline in both video panels with cosmetic orange-and-white cones and black bases; no moving target dot or privileged overlay.
image_sampling: 31 images at fixed one-second times from 0 through 30 s; all 301 noisy 10 Hz rows.
